objective: Repair historical release test expectations without changing application or publisher behavior
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub current main ce164744c55428fb43c51f5d4bf1a2c74ee1616f has merged PR #672 and existing active ruleset. This is source-only evidence, not a deployed OTA fingerprint.
chosenApproach: Update six existing legacy release contract tests to assert current explicit main push marker and absence of manual Android/Web publish dispatch, retaining all historical content and product assertions.
selectionRationale: Existing release tests describe retired manual workflows and falsely fail when modern production safeguards operate; updating only the assertions provides truthful regression coverage while avoiding app or release workflow mutation.
alternativeApproaches: Re-enable unguarded manual publisher solely to satisfy stale tests (rejected)
Delete historical tests (rejected, loses functional checks)
Update stale assertions to actual guarded source while retaining tests (selected)

No app, production workflow, migration, RLS, credentials, native runtime or user data changes.
No production OTA or web publish.
preserveBehaviors: Legacy read-only release history remains testable.
